title: Verogen ForenSeq DNA Signature Prep Kit Part 5/5: Pooling
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters as required above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download your protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware JSON files (.json) if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload your .py protocol file to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App; consult support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” to start the pooling protocol.
